description: This file implements two classes for Text-to-Speech (TTS) services in the Inworld AI platform: InworldHttpTTSService (HTTP-based) and InworldTTSService (WebSocket-based). It includes methods for starting, stopping, canceling, and processing TTS streams, handling WebSocket connections, and managing word timestamps and audio frames.

classes.name: InworldHttpTTSService
classes.description: HTTP-based TTS service supporting streaming and non-streaming modes, with word timestamp tracking.

classes.name: InworldTTSService
classes.description: WebSocket-based TTS service with bidirectional streaming, multiple audio contexts, and detailed message handling.

methods.name: can_generate_metrics
methods.description: Indicates support for metrics generation.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the TTS service, setting sample rate and starting metrics.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the TTS service.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels ongoing TTS operations.

methods.name: push_frame
methods.description: Handles incoming frames and updates internal state accordingly.

methods.name: _calculate_word_times
methods.description: Calculates word timestamps from API response, maintaining cumulative timing.

methods.name: run_tts
methods.description: Main method to generate TTS audio, handling streaming or non-streaming responses.

methods.name: _process_streaming_response
methods.description: Processes streaming audio chunks and timestamp info from API response.

methods.name: _process_non_streaming_response
methods.description: Processes complete audio response and timestamps from API.

methods.name: _process_audio_chunk
methods.description: Converts raw audio chunks into audio frames.

methods.name: _handle_interruption
methods.description: Handles interruptions, closing contexts if needed.

methods.name: _get_websocket
methods.description: Retrieves the current WebSocket connection.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes WebSocket connection and starts message handler.

methods.name: _disconnect
methods.description: Closes WebSocket connection and cancels message handler.

methods.name: _connect_websocket
methods.description: Handles WebSocket connection setup with headers.

methods.name: _disconnect_websocket
methods.description: Closes WebSocket connection cleanly.

methods.name: _receive_messages
methods.description: Asynchronously processes incoming WebSocket messages, handling audio chunks and context events.

methods.name: _send_context
methods.description: Sends a create context message over WebSocket.

methods.name: _send_text
methods.description: Sends text message for TTS over WebSocket.

methods.name: _send_flush
methods.description: Sends a flush command to the WebSocket to process buffered text.

methods.name: _send_close_context
methods.description: Closes a WebSocket audio context.

methods.name: run_tts
methods.description: Generates TTS audio via WebSocket, managing connection and context.
